vibe.verdict: The North Pole cafeteria has Siblings Anonymous, the repo man dogs, the cocoa for nice kids and Fred's halo note.
missing: Slam at the top of the naughty list (wink)

Swap 'Iced gingerbread men' for 'Chirp Chirp birdhouse cookies', the replica Nick gives Fred.
Swap the house note on 'Caramel popcorn balls' for 'DJ Donnie plays the same Santa song on repeat.'
